outcome.description: `success` or the code of the failure.

target.description: The user acted on, when the entry is about a user.

name.description: The name to show; never an email address.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Match on `code`, not on the text.

errors.description: Present for validation failures: one entry per invalid field.

traceId.description: The trace of the request, for support.

erasureBegun.description: True once erasing a deleted user has begun.

name.description: The name to show; never an email address.

info.description: Everything lives under /api/v1. Every call needs a user's bearer token; browsers reach the API only through the Next.js server. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code`, the `traceId` of the request and, for validation failures, `errors`.
